29th October, 2026 
To 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, Plot No. C/1, G Block, 
Bandra Kurla Complex 
Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400 051 
To  
BSE Limited  
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers  
25th floor, Dalal Street, Fort 
Mumbai – 400 001 
Symbol: ADROITIND 
Scrip Code: 544950 
 
Sub: Submission of Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call for Q2FY27 Results 
This is with reference to Regulation 30(6) read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”). 
We hereby submit the audio link of the earnings call held with analysts/investors in respect of 
the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended September 
30, 2026, conducted through digital means on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 5:00 P.M. (IST), 
which is available on the Company’s website. 
 
The link of the said recording is as follows:  
https://adroitindustries.com/conference-call/audio-recordings 
We request you to kindly take the aforesaid information on record. 
Yours faithfully, 
For Adroit Industries (India) Limited 
 
 
Saurabh Sangla 
Chairman & Managing Director 
DIN: 00206069 
 
 
 
Saurabh 
Sangla
Digitally signed 
by Saurabh
